title: Splitting a Commit That Did Too Much
description: Tom needs one mixed commit split into separate bug-fix and feature commits for a cleaner changelog.
objective: Split the mixed commit into two clean commits without changing the final project content.

whatToDo.text: Inspect the branch history and find the commit containing both changes.
Split that commit into a bug-fix commit and a feature commit.
Keep the other commits and final project content unchanged.

hints: Use interactive rebase to stop at the mixed commit, then reset that commit while keeping its changes in your working tree.
Stage and commit the bug fix and new feature separately, then continue the rebase.

intro.message: Tom found a commit that combines a bug fix with a new feature. Let's clean up the history so each change has its own commit.

splitCommit.message: Nice. The mixed work has been separated into its own commits.

success.message: Perfect, changelog will actually make sense now. Thanks for taking the time to split that properly.

failure.message: The history still isn't clean. Split the mixed commit into separate bug-fix and feature commits while preserving the surrounding history and final content.
